messages:
jordan-support: FYI customer reported an issue where tool/function-calls over streaming end up with malformed JSON args (partial/truncated) and their app throws a schema error. ticket #5421, example payload attached. :rotating_light:
alyssa: Can you paste the raw stream they saw? small example is fine, and the SDK + service version they used.
jordan-support: Here's the minimal capture they provided. They use our hosted API with streaming SSE. Notice JSON cuts off mid-arg: 
```
event: message
data: {"tool": "payment_lookup", "args": {"invoice_id": "inv_12345", "amount": 199.99, "metadata": {"user": "u_999""
# stream stops here (missing closing braces)
```
carla-eng: Hmm. That looks like the SSE chunk closed abruptly. Do we have the request-id or x-rw-request header from the customer's attempt? Also need service logs for that timeslice (2336604209-2336604220).
victor-sre: Hypothesis: upstream edge or proxy is slicing the last chunk — possibly due to client abort or connection reset. Two quick checks: 1) verify Content-Length vs chunked semantics on the incoming connection; 2) tcpdump on the edge to see final packets. Also check nginx/proxy keepalive and proxy_buffer settings.
mike: Short-term mitigation: advise customer to disable streaming for that call or enable the SDK option `bufferFinalChunk: true` if available. We can also add a server-side tolerance to retry small tail fragments for tool calls for a short window.
sara: We saw something like this back in Q3 last year when a misbehaving CDN dropped the last packet if the client closed early. That manifested as incomplete JSON in SSE responses. Increasing proxy timeouts/suppressing early-client disconnects fixed it for them.
alyssa: @jordan-support please ask customer for a HAR / full TLS capture (they can redact PII) and the SDK version. Also ask whether they're using our proxy or a custom edge in front of the SDK. I'll create a reproducible job once we have that. :eyes:
jordan-support: Customer says they're on node-sdk v1.4.2 and they have an edge proxy (FastEdge) in front. They attached a small node repro they ran that reproduces it ~1/5 attempts. Repro steps: open SSE, stream first 60% of payload, then send a zero-length FIN prematurely from client.
carla-eng: Please paste the Node repro snippet. If it's deterministic we can run it in our staging infra.
jordan-support: Node repro (redacted):
```js
// simplified repro: open SSE POST to /v1/stream, write first 120 bytes, then close socket abruptly
const net = require('net');
const req = `POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: application/sse

`;// then write chunked pieces and call socket.end() early
// observed result: server sent final data but client closed, final bytes lost on wire
```
victor-sre: If the client closes before the final chunk ack, there's a race where the edge may drop the tail. Can we instrument the edge to log when downstream closes mid-upload? Add a metric for `downstream_closed_during_response` and surface the last-seen content-length / chunk counts.
mike: Product question: should we treat tool-call arg parsing as tolerant for streaming truncation? We could buffer incomplete JSON for X ms and attempt lightweight reassembly. Tradeoff: added mem/latency.
sara: For customers behind third-party proxies we should provide guidance: set `Connection: keep-alive` and ensure their edge doesn't force early FIN on partial uploads. Also add a KB article.
alyssa: Next actions: 1) jordan: request HAR + TLS capture + exact SDK config from customer. 2) carla + victor: try repro in staging with FastEdge mimic and run tcpdump to confirm tail dropped. 3) mike: evaluate short-term SDK `bufferFinalChunk` toggle and product note. 4) sara: draft KB explaining proxy timeouts and streaming caveats.
jordan-support: Confirmed with customer I've requested captures. I've also suggested reverting to non-streamed calls until we confirm. I'll update ticket #5421 and link back here when they upload the capture. :white_check_mark:
customer-bot: automated note: upload received (redacted_har_5421.har), size 86KB.
carla-eng: Got the HAR, running repro now in staging (2336607500). Will post results + pcap.
victor-sre: Ran tcpdump. I can see the server pushed the final bytes but the downstream RST happened before ACK of last packet. That matches early-client-close. Attaching pcap id pcap-5421 (internal).
mike: Given that, mitigation guidance + SDK option seems best short-term. We'll avoid changing server parsing now.
alyssa: Thanks team. Keeping this thread open until customer confirms non-streamed flow works or we have a permanent fix.
carla-eng: Follow-up: adding a guard in the serving runtime to hold last 512 bytes of the stream for 200ms before marking tool args complete reduced repro rate in staging to 0/100. Will propose a small patch with feature flag for rollout.
mike: Sounds good. Let's coordinate a canary once patch is ready.
jordan-support: Noted. Will communicate planned canary and mitigation steps to customer. Thread closed when customer verifies.
